name: TF3OpenAPI day clock
description: A game day runs from 00:00 to 23:59, minute by minute (24 minutes of play at normal speed), and the date changes at midnight. The sun and moon follow that clock unless switched off in the settings. Years pass correspondingly more slowly. Uses the game's own calendar speed and time of day; both can be set back with the game's own controls. Not supported together with the Timetables mod.

params.name: Sun and moon
params.tooltip:
Follow the clock: day and night come at the clock's hours.
As the game sets them: the clock and the long day stay, the sky is left to the game's own cycle.
